layouts.name: Loheac
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Full paved road circuit uses the northern triangle, internal hairpin and rounded southern outer curve; service and shortened branches excluded. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 2014.1 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

layouts.name: Loheac Rallycross
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Rallycross main course uses the full northern straight and broad eastern return, excluding the shorter northern alternative. The event regulations identify a 1,088 m main lap and 1,070 m alternative lap; the independently mapped longer branch measures 1,079.2 m. The catalogue scalar 1,409 m differs. Course branches agree with the configuration picture; all coordinates remain exact source nodes. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 1079.2 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
